[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Create a guest list.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Design a communication plan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Plan activities and entertainment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Plan for RSVPs and ticketing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Start spreading the word.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include starting early, being flexible, considering hiring a professional event planner, and having a plan for handling RSVPs, cancellations, and refunds.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of effective ways to reach out to classmates, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Create a private Facebook group or event page.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Send personalized emails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Make phone calls and send texts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Identify classmate ambassadors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Create a class newsletter or update.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Reach out for classmate testimonials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Offer early bird incentives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Create a reunion website.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Create a reunion video.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Send follow-up reminders.
